account.description: Business that represents a customer or potential customer. The company that is billed in business transactions.

accountnumber.description: Type an ID number or code for the account to quickly search and identify the account in system views.

address1_city.description: Type the city for the primary address.

address1_country.description: Type the country or region for the primary address.

cb_accountmanager.name: cb_accountmanager
cb_accountmanager.label: Account Manager
cb_accountmanager.description: Name of the Contoso Bikes account manager responsible for the customer relationship and renewals.

cb_customersince.name: cb_customersince

cb_customersince.description: Date the customer placed their first order with Contoso Bikes.

cb_customertier.name: cb_customertier
cb_customertier.label: Customer Tier
cb_customertier.description: Commercial importance of the customer. Strategic = top accounts with executive sponsorship; Key = large recurring accounts; Growth = smaller accounts with expansion potential; Standard = everyone else.

cb_salesregion.name: cb_salesregion
cb_salesregion.label: Sales Region
cb_salesregion.description: Contoso Bikes sales region that owns the customer relationship.

cb_segment.name: cb_segment
cb_segment.label: Segment
cb_segment.description: Customer's line of business, which determines which bike models and agreement types typically apply.

customertypecode.description: Select the category that best describes the relationship between the account and your organization.

description.name: description

description.description: Type additional information to describe the account, such as an excerpt from the company's website.

emailaddress1.name: emailaddress1
emailaddress1.label: Email
emailaddress1.description: Type the primary email address for the account.

industrycode.name: industrycode
industrycode.label: Industry
industrycode.description: Select the account's primary industry for use in marketing segmentation and demographic analysis.

modifiedon.name: modifiedon
modifiedon.label: Modified On

name.name: name
name.label: Account Name
name.description: Type the company or business name.

numberofemployees.name: numberofemployees
numberofemployees.label: Number of Employees
numberofemployees.description: Type the number of employees that work at the account for use in marketing segmentation and demographic analysis.

parentaccountid.name: parentaccountid
parentaccountid.label: Parent Account
parentaccountid.description: Choose the parent account associated with this account to show parent and child businesses in reporting and analytics.

revenue.name: revenue
revenue.label: Annual Revenue
revenue.description: Type the annual revenue for the account, used as an indicator in financial performance analysis.

statecode.name: statecode
statecode.label: Status
statecode.description: Shows whether the account is active or inactive. Inactive accounts are read-only and can't be edited unless they are reactivated.

telephone1.name: telephone1
telephone1.label: Main Phone
telephone1.description: Type the main phone number for this account.

websiteurl.name: websiteurl
websiteurl.label: Website
websiteurl.description: Type the account's website URL to get quick details about the company profile.

cb_bikemodel.name: cb_bikemodel
cb_bikemodel.label: Bike Model
cb_bikemodel.description: A bike model in the Contoso Bikes catalog. Sold on sales orders, built on production orders, and registered per serial number when delivered to customers.

cb_launchdate.name: cb_launchdate
cb_launchdate.label: Launch Date
cb_launchdate.description: Date the model became available for order.

cb_lifecyclestatus.name: cb_lifecyclestatus
cb_lifecyclestatus.label: Lifecycle Status
cb_lifecyclestatus.description: Where the model is in its lifecycle. Only Active and Phase-out models can be ordered.

cb_listprice.name: cb_listprice
cb_listprice.label: List Price
cb_listprice.description: Standard list price per bike in SEK, before agreement discounts.

cb_modelcode.name: cb_modelcode
cb_modelcode.label: Model Code
cb_modelcode.description: Unique model code, e.g. URB-E200. Used across all Contoso Bikes apps (orders, production, warranty) to refer to the model.

cb_modeldescription.name: cb_modeldescription
cb_modeldescription.label: Description
cb_modeldescription.description: Marketing and technical description of the model and its intended use.

cb_motor.name: cb_motor
cb_motor.label: Motor & Battery
cb_motor.description: Drive system summary, e.g. 250W mid-drive, 625Wh battery. Empty for non-electric models.

cb_warrantymonths.name: cb_warrantymonths
cb_warrantymonths.label: Warranty (Months)
cb_warrantymonths.description: Standard warranty period in months from delivery date.

createdon.name: createdon

createdon.description: Date and time when the record was created.

modifiedon.name: modifiedon
modifiedon.label: Modified On
modifiedon.description: Date and time when the record was modified.

statuscode.name: statuscode
statuscode.label: Status Reason
statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the Bike Model

cb_salesagreement.name: cb_salesagreement
cb_salesagreement.label: Sales Agreement
cb_salesagreement.description: A commercial agreement with a customer — fleet lease, volume purchase, service contract or dealer agreement. Tracks contract value, term and renewal outlook. Renewals of large agreements are the most important commercial events for Contoso Bikes.

cb_agreementnotes.name: cb_agreementnotes
cb_agreementnotes.label: Account Manager Notes
cb_agreementnotes.description: Free-text notes from the account manager about the agreement, customer sentiment and renewal negotiations.

cb_agreementstatus.name: cb_agreementstatus
cb_agreementstatus.label: Agreement Status
cb_agreementstatus.description: Commercial status. Up for Renewal = within the renewal negotiation window (normally the last 120 days before the end date).

cb_agreementtype.name: cb_agreementtype
cb_agreementtype.label: Agreement Type
cb_agreementtype.description: Fleet Lease = bikes leased to the customer incl. service; Volume Purchase = framework for discounted purchases; Service Contract = maintenance of an existing fleet; Dealer Agreement = resale terms for retail dealers.

cb_annualvalue.name: cb_annualvalue
cb_annualvalue.label: Annual Value
cb_annualvalue.description: Expected yearly revenue from the agreement in SEK.

cb_enddate.name: cb_enddate
cb_enddate.label: End Date
cb_enddate.description: Last day of the agreement; the renewal deadline.

cb_fleetsize.name: cb_fleetsize
cb_fleetsize.label: Fleet Size
cb_fleetsize.description: Number of bikes covered by the agreement.

cb_renewalprobability.name: cb_renewalprobability
cb_renewalprobability.label: Renewal Probability (%)
cb_renewalprobability.description: Account manager's estimate (0-100) of how likely the customer is to renew.

cb_renewalrisk.name: cb_renewalrisk
cb_renewalrisk.label: Renewal Risk
cb_renewalrisk.description: Account manager's assessment of the risk of losing the renewal. High = customer has raised concerns or competitor is involved.

cb_startdate.name: cb_startdate
cb_startdate.label: Start Date
cb_startdate.description: First day the agreement is in force.

cb_totalcontractvalue.name: cb_totalcontractvalue
cb_totalcontractvalue.label: Total Contract Value
cb_totalcontractvalue.description: Total revenue over the full agreement term in SEK.

statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the Sales Agreement

cb_salesorder.name: cb_salesorder
cb_salesorder.label: Sales Order
cb_salesorder.description: A customer order for bikes. Each order is fulfilled by one or more production orders in Production Planning, which reference the sales order number.

cb_deliveryrisk.name: cb_deliveryrisk
cb_deliveryrisk.label: Delivery Risk
cb_deliveryrisk.description: Whether the promised delivery date will be met. At Risk = a production or supply problem threatens the date; Late = promised date has passed or certainly will be missed.

cb_orderdate.name: cb_orderdate
cb_orderdate.label: Order Date
cb_orderdate.description: Date the customer placed the order.

cb_ordernotes.name: cb_ordernotes
cb_ordernotes.label: Order Notes
cb_ordernotes.description: Notes about the order, special requirements or delivery issues.

cb_orderpriority.name: cb_orderpriority
cb_orderpriority.label: Priority
cb_orderpriority.description: Fulfilment priority. Critical = tied to a strategic account or a renewal.

cb_ordervalue.name: cb_ordervalue
cb_ordervalue.label: Order Value
cb_ordervalue.description: Total order value in SEK (sum of order lines).

cb_promiseddelivery.name: cb_promiseddelivery
cb_promiseddelivery.label: Promised Delivery
cb_promiseddelivery.description: Delivery date Contoso Bikes committed to.

cb_requesteddelivery.name: cb_requesteddelivery
cb_requesteddelivery.label: Requested Delivery
cb_requesteddelivery.description: Delivery date the customer asked for.

createdon.name: createdon
createdon.label: Created On
createdon.description: Date and time when the record was created.

modifiedon.name: modifiedon
modifiedon.label: Modified On
modifiedon.description: Date and time when the record was modified.

statuscode.name: statuscode
statuscode.label: Status Reason
statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the Sales Order

cb_salesorderline.name: cb_salesorderline
cb_salesorderline.label: Sales Order Line
cb_salesorderline.description: One line on a sales order: a quantity of a specific bike model at an agreed unit price.

cb_linenumber.name: cb_linenumber
cb_linenumber.label: Line Number
cb_linenumber.description: Position of the line on the order (10, 20, 30...).

cb_linetotal.name: cb_linetotal
cb_linetotal.label: Line Total
cb_linetotal.description: Quantity x unit price in SEK.

cb_unitprice.name: cb_unitprice
cb_unitprice.label: Unit Price
cb_unitprice.description: Agreed price per bike in SEK after discounts.

statecode.description: Status of the Sales Order Line

statuscode.name: statuscode
statuscode.label: Status Reason
statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the Sales Order Line

cb_registeredbike.name: cb_registeredbike
cb_registeredbike.label: Registered Bike
cb_registeredbike.description: An individual bike delivered to a customer, identified by its frame serial number. Warranty cases are logged against a registered bike.

cb_bikestatus.name: cb_bikestatus
cb_bikestatus.label: Bike Status
cb_bikestatus.description: Current operational status of the bike at the customer.

cb_deliverydate.name: cb_deliverydate
cb_deliverydate.label: Delivery Date
cb_deliverydate.description: Date the bike was delivered to the customer; the warranty starts on this date.

cb_salesordernumber.name: cb_salesordernumber
cb_salesordernumber.label: Sales Order Number
cb_salesordernumber.description: Number of the sales order the bike was delivered under (e.g. SO-24017), as used in Key Account Hub.

cb_warrantyexpiry.name: cb_warrantyexpiry
cb_warrantyexpiry.label: Warranty Expiry
cb_warrantyexpiry.description: Last day of the warranty (delivery date + the model's warranty months).

createdon.description: Date and time when the record was created.

statuscode.name: statuscode
statuscode.label: Status Reason
statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the Registered Bike

cb_warrantycase.name: cb_warrantycase
cb_warrantycase.label: Warranty Case
cb_warrantycase.description: A warranty claim from a customer about a failure on a delivered bike. Records which part failed (by part number), how severe it is and how it was resolved. Recurring failures of the same part number indicate a supplier quality problem.

cb_affectedbikes.name: cb_affectedbikes
cb_affectedbikes.label: Affected Bikes
cb_affectedbikes.description: Number of bikes in the customer's fleet affected by this issue (a case can cover several bikes with the same failure).

cb_casedescription.name: cb_casedescription
cb_casedescription.label: Problem Description
cb_casedescription.description: Customer's description of the failure and the technician's findings.

cb_casestatus.name: cb_casestatus
cb_casestatus.label: Case Status
cb_casestatus.description: Where the case is in handling. Waiting for Parts = repair blocked until replacement parts arrive.

cb_escalated.name: cb_escalated
cb_escalated.label: Escalated
cb_escalated.description: Yes when the customer or account manager has escalated the case to management.

cb_estimatedcost.name: cb_estimatedcost
cb_estimatedcost.label: Estimated Cost
cb_estimatedcost.description: Estimated warranty cost in SEK (parts, labour, logistics).

cb_failedpartnumber.name: cb_failedpartnumber
cb_failedpartnumber.label: Failed Part Number
cb_failedpartnumber.description: Part number of the component that failed, e.g. BRK-220. Same part numbers as in Supplier & Procurement and in the bill of materials in Production Planning.

cb_failurecategory.name: cb_failurecategory
cb_failurecategory.label: Failure Category
cb_failurecategory.description: Which system of the bike failed.

cb_reportedon.name: cb_reportedon
cb_reportedon.label: Reported On
cb_reportedon.description: Date the customer reported the problem.

cb_resolution.name: cb_resolution
cb_resolution.label: Resolution
cb_resolution.description: How the case was resolved, or why it was rejected.

cb_resolvedon.name: cb_resolvedon
cb_resolvedon.label: Resolved On
cb_resolvedon.description: Date the case was resolved or rejected.

cb_severity.name: cb_severity
cb_severity.label: Severity
cb_severity.description: Impact of the failure. Safety Critical = rider safety affected (e.g. braking); such bikes must be taken out of service.

cb_sladue.name: cb_sladue
cb_sladue.label: SLA Due
cb_sladue.description: Date by which the case must be resolved under the customer's service terms.

cb_title.name: cb_title
cb_title.label: Title
cb_title.description: Short summary of the reported problem.

createdon.name: createdon
createdon.label: Created On
createdon.description: Date and time when the record was created.

modifiedon.name: modifiedon
modifiedon.label: Modified On
modifiedon.description: Date and time when the record was modified.

statuscode.name: statuscode
statuscode.label: Status Reason
statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the Warranty Case

cb_returnauthorization.name: cb_returnauthorization
cb_returnauthorization.label: Return Authorization
cb_returnauthorization.description: A return merchandise authorization (RMA) for defective parts sent back from the field, usually raised from a warranty case and claimed back from the supplier.

cb_creditamount.name: cb_creditamount
cb_creditamount.label: Credit Amount
cb_creditamount.description: Amount in SEK credited (or expected) from the supplier.

cb_partnumber.name: cb_partnumber
cb_partnumber.label: Part Number
cb_partnumber.description: Part number being returned, e.g. BRK-220.

cb_rmastatus.name: cb_rmastatus
cb_rmastatus.label: RMA Status
cb_rmastatus.description: Credited = the supplier has credited Contoso Bikes for the defective parts.

createdon.name: createdon
createdon.label: Created On
createdon.description: Date and time when the record was created.

modifiedon.name: modifiedon
modifiedon.label: Modified On
modifiedon.description: Date and time when the record was modified.

statuscode.name: statuscode
statuscode.label: Status Reason
statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the Return Authorization

cb_supplier.name: cb_supplier
cb_supplier.label: Supplier
cb_supplier.description: A company that supplies components to Contoso Bikes. Supplier status and on-time delivery rate summarise how reliable the supplier is.

cb_contactemail.name: cb_contactemail
cb_contactemail.label: Contact Email
cb_contactemail.description: Email of the supplier's key account contact.

cb_contactname.name: cb_contactname
cb_contactname.label: Key Contact
cb_contactname.description: Name of the supplier's key account contact.

cb_ontimedelivery.name: cb_ontimedelivery
cb_ontimedelivery.label: On-Time Delivery (%)
cb_ontimedelivery.description: Share of purchase order deliveries received on or before the promised date over the last 12 months.

cb_performancerating.name: cb_performancerating
cb_performancerating.label: Performance Rating
cb_performancerating.description: Overall supplier score 1-5 combining quality, delivery and responsiveness (5 = best).

cb_suppliernotes.name: cb_suppliernotes
cb_suppliernotes.label: Buyer Notes
cb_suppliernotes.description: Buyer's notes about the supplier relationship, risks and ongoing issues.

cb_supplierstatus.name: cb_supplierstatus
cb_supplierstatus.label: Supplier Status
cb_supplierstatus.description: Approved = normal; On Watch = performance or quality concerns under review; Probation = formal improvement plan, no new parts awarded; Blocked = no new purchase orders.

createdon.name: createdon
createdon.label: Created On
createdon.description: Date and time when the record was created.

modifiedon.name: modifiedon
modifiedon.label: Modified On
modifiedon.description: Date and time when the record was modified.

statuscode.name: statuscode
statuscode.label: Status Reason
statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the Supplier

cb_part.name: cb_part
cb_part.label: Part
cb_part.description: A purchased component, identified by its part number. Part numbers are used across Contoso Bikes apps: bill of materials in Production Planning and failed parts on warranty cases.

cb_leadtimedays.name: cb_leadtimedays
cb_leadtimedays.label: Lead Time (Days)
cb_leadtimedays.description: Standard supplier lead time from order to delivery.

cb_partcategory.name: cb_partcategory
cb_partcategory.label: Part Category
cb_partcategory.description: Which bike system the part belongs to (same categories as warranty failure categories).

cb_partname.name: cb_partname
cb_partname.label: Part Name
cb_partname.description: Descriptive name, e.g. Hydraulic Brake Caliper.

cb_partstatus.name: cb_partstatus
cb_partstatus.label: Part Status
cb_partstatus.description: Quality Hold = incoming stock is quarantined pending a quality investigation; held stock cannot be used in production.

cb_safetystock.name: cb_safetystock
cb_safetystock.label: Safety Stock
cb_safetystock.description: Minimum units to keep in stock. Stock on hand below safety stock means production is at risk.

cb_singlesource.name: cb_singlesource
cb_singlesource.label: Single Source
cb_singlesource.description: Yes when only one qualified supplier exists for the part — a supply risk.

cb_stockonhand.name: cb_stockonhand
cb_stockonhand.label: Stock on Hand
cb_stockonhand.description: Usable units in the warehouse (excludes stock on quality hold).

cb_stockstatus.name: cb_stockstatus
cb_stockstatus.label: Stock Status
cb_stockstatus.description: Stock situation set by the supply planner, comparing stock on hand with safety stock.

cb_unitcost.name: cb_unitcost
cb_unitcost.label: Unit Cost
cb_unitcost.description: Purchase price per unit in SEK.

cb_purchaseorder.name: cb_purchaseorder
cb_purchaseorder.label: Purchase Order
cb_purchaseorder.description: An order from Contoso Bikes to a supplier for one part. Delay (days) shows how late the latest expected delivery is compared with the promised date.

cb_delaydays.name: cb_delaydays
cb_delaydays.label: Delay (Days)
cb_delaydays.description: Days between promised date and expected (or actual) delivery date; 0 = on time.

cb_expecteddate.name: cb_expecteddate
cb_expecteddate.label: Expected Date
cb_expecteddate.description: Latest expected delivery date based on supplier updates.

cb_orderdate.name: cb_orderdate
cb_orderdate.label: Order Date
cb_orderdate.description: Date the PO was sent to the supplier.

cb_ponotes.name: cb_ponotes
cb_ponotes.label: PO Notes
cb_ponotes.description: Buyer notes, e.g. supplier explanations for delays.

cb_promiseddate.name: cb_promiseddate
cb_promiseddate.label: Promised Date
cb_promiseddate.description: Delivery date the supplier committed to.

cb_receiveddate.name: cb_receiveddate
cb_receiveddate.label: Received Date
cb_receiveddate.description: Date the goods were received in full.

createdon.name: createdon
createdon.label: Created On
createdon.description: Date and time when the record was created.

modifiedon.name: modifiedon
modifiedon.label: Modified On
modifiedon.description: Date and time when the record was modified.

statuscode.name: statuscode
statuscode.label: Status Reason
statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the Purchase Order

cb_qualityincident.name: cb_qualityincident
cb_qualityincident.label: Quality Incident
cb_qualityincident.description: A supplier quality problem with a part (non-conformance), from detection through root cause and corrective action to closure.

cb_affectedquantity.name: cb_affectedquantity
cb_affectedquantity.label: Affected Quantity
cb_affectedquantity.description: Number of parts suspected or confirmed defective.

cb_closedon.name: cb_closedon
cb_closedon.label: Closed On
cb_closedon.description: Date the incident was closed after verified corrective action.

cb_correctiveaction.name: cb_correctiveaction
cb_correctiveaction.label: Corrective Action
cb_correctiveaction.description: Actions taken by the supplier and Contoso Bikes to fix and prevent the problem.

cb_defectdescription.name: cb_defectdescription
cb_defectdescription.label: Defect Description
cb_defectdescription.description: What is wrong with the parts and how it shows.

cb_detectionsource.name: cb_detectionsource
cb_detectionsource.label: Detected At
cb_detectionsource.description: Where the problem was found. Field Failure / Warranty = found through customer warranty cases.

cb_qiseverity.name: cb_qiseverity
cb_qiseverity.label: Severity
cb_qiseverity.description: Critical = safety risk or field failures at customers; Major = parts unusable, affects production; Minor = cosmetic or easily reworked.

cb_rootcause.name: cb_rootcause
cb_rootcause.label: Root Cause
cb_rootcause.description: Confirmed root cause (empty while still under analysis).

createdon.name: createdon
createdon.label: Created On
createdon.description: Date and time when the record was created.

modifiedon.name: modifiedon
modifiedon.label: Modified On
modifiedon.description: Date and time when the record was modified.

statuscode.name: statuscode
statuscode.label: Status Reason
statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the Quality Incident

cb_productionline.name: cb_productionline
cb_productionline.label: Production Line
cb_productionline.description: An assembly line in a Contoso Bikes plant, with its capacity and current utilization.

cb_dailycapacity.name: cb_dailycapacity
cb_dailycapacity.label: Daily Capacity
cb_dailycapacity.description: Bikes the line can assemble per day at full staffing.

cb_linenotes.name: cb_linenotes
cb_linenotes.label: Line Notes
cb_linenotes.description: Plant manager's notes on the line's current situation.

cb_linestatus.name: cb_linestatus
cb_linestatus.label: Line Status
cb_linestatus.description: Operational status. Reduced Capacity typically means parts shortages or staffing gaps.

cb_linetype.name: cb_linetype
cb_linetype.label: Line Type
cb_linetype.description: Which bike categories the line assembles.

cb_plant.name: cb_plant
cb_plant.label: Plant
cb_plant.description: Plant (city) where the line is located.

cb_utilization.name: cb_utilization
cb_utilization.label: Utilization (%)
cb_utilization.description: Current share of capacity in use over the last two weeks.

cb_productionorder.name: cb_productionorder
cb_productionorder.label: Production Order
cb_productionorder.description: An order to assemble a quantity of one bike model on a production line, normally to fulfil a customer sales order (referenced by sales order number). Forecast finish later than planned finish means the customer delivery is at risk.

cb_forecastfinish.name: cb_forecastfinish
cb_forecastfinish.label: Forecast Finish
cb_forecastfinish.description: Planner's current estimate of the completion date. Later than planned finish = delay.

cb_holdreason.name: cb_holdreason
cb_holdreason.label: Hold Reason
cb_holdreason.description: Why the order is on hold or at risk.

cb_missingpartnumber.name: cb_missingpartnumber
cb_missingpartnumber.label: Missing Part Number
cb_missingpartnumber.description: Part number that is short and blocking or delaying the order, e.g. MC-48V (see Supplier & Procurement).

cb_plannedfinish.name: cb_plannedfinish
cb_plannedfinish.label: Planned Finish
cb_plannedfinish.description: Scheduled completion date (planned so the bikes can ship by the sales order's promised delivery).

cb_productionnotes.name: cb_productionnotes
cb_productionnotes.label: Planner Notes
cb_productionnotes.description: Production planner's notes about status, shortages and recovery plans.

cb_productionstatus.name: cb_productionstatus
cb_productionstatus.label: Production Status
cb_productionstatus.description: Status of the production order. On Hold = cannot proceed (see hold reason).

cb_salesordernumber.name: cb_salesordernumber
cb_salesordernumber.label: Sales Order Number
cb_salesordernumber.description: Customer sales order this production order fulfils, e.g. SO-24051 (see Key Account Hub). Empty for stock builds.

createdon.label: Created On
createdon.description: Date and time when the record was created.

modifiedon.label: Modified On
modifiedon.description: Date and time when the record was modified.

statuscode.name: statuscode
statuscode.label: Status Reason
statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the Production Order

cb_bomline.name: cb_bomline
cb_bomline.label: BOM Line
cb_bomline.description: One component in a bike model's bill of materials: which part number, how many per bike, and whether it is critical (no bike can be finished without it).

cb_criticalcomponent.name: cb_criticalcomponent
cb_criticalcomponent.label: Critical Component
cb_criticalcomponent.description: Yes when the bike cannot be finished or shipped without this part (no substitute).

cb_partnumber.name: cb_partnumber
cb_partnumber.label: Part Number
cb_partnumber.description: Part number of the component (see Supplier & Procurement), e.g. BRK-220.

cb_quantityper.name: cb_quantityper
cb_quantityper.label: Quantity per Bike
cb_quantityper.description: How many of this part go into one bike.

createdon.name: createdon
createdon.label: Created On
createdon.description: Date and time when the record was created.

modifiedon.name: modifiedon
modifiedon.label: Modified On
modifiedon.description: Date and time when the record was modified.

statuscode.name: statuscode
statuscode.label: Status Reason
statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the BOM Line
